status: 25 design-reference profiles, no active clinical calculators

profiles.name: approximate_MAP
profiles.limits: Approximation; source measured MAP retained, limited in nonstandard waveforms/rhythm.

profiles.name: pulse_pressure
profiles.limits: Same site/acquisition; negative difference is inconsistent and prompts review.

profiles.name: shock_index
profiles.limits: Context/medication/rhythm dependent; not a standalone shock classifier.

profiles.name: CI
profiles.limits: Declared approved BSA method; indexed distinct from absolute.

profiles.name: SV
profiles.limits: Aligned perfusing HR and CO; no incompatible support state.

profiles.name: SVI
profiles.limits: Exact indexing method.

profiles.name: SVR
profiles.limits: Compartment/method/time coherent; RAP/CVP substitution requires approved context.

profiles.name: PVR
profiles.limits: PAWP validity and method; multiply by80 only as explicit conversion.

profiles.name: TPG
profiles.limits: No automatic PH diagnosis.

profiles.name: DPG
profiles.limits: Measurement error/phase limits; no standalone treatment inference.

profiles.name: CPO
profiles.limits: Adopted conversion/convention; no universal escalation cutoff.

profiles.name: CPI
profiles.limits: Profile must distinguish CPO and CPI.

profiles.name: PAPi
profiles.limits: Near-zero/error/support/PH limitations; no universal RV cutoff.

profiles.name: CaO2
profiles.required_inputs: Hb g/dL; SaO2 fraction; PaO2 mmHg
profiles.limits: Constants are educational convention pending local adoption; measured co-oximetry and method limits.

profiles.name: DO2
profiles.limits: No isolated transfusion or CO target.

profiles.name: DO2I
profiles.limits: Aligned method and indexed semantics.

profiles.name: OER
profiles.limits: SvO2/ScvO2 cannot be swapped silently; content is not tension.

profiles.name: CO2_gap
profiles.limits: Label compartment and sampling interval; not standalone target.

profiles.name: lactate_decrement
profiles.limits: Not measured lactate clearance; negative decrement is rise.

profiles.name: test_flow_change
profiles.limits: Eligibility/uncertainty/threshold protocol required; no universal cut point.

profiles.name: infusion_dose_mass
profiles.limits: Actual bag/delivery basis; educational arithmetic not a drug instruction.

profiles.name: infusion_dose_weighted
profiles.limits: Do not silently change weight or convert activity units to mass.

profiles.name: activity_rate
profiles.limits: Drug/product activity convention; not mcg/kg/min.

profiles.name: known_delivered_volume
profiles.limits: Derived estimate separate from source total; gaps remain unknown.

profiles.name: CPP
profiles.limits: Specialist approved context; no default neurocritical target.
